Title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission
Writer: Kôhei Horikoshi, Yôsuke Kuroda, Hitoshi Nagai
Actors: Daiki Yamashita, Nobuhiko Okamoto, Yûki Kaji
Plot: When a cult of terrorists ruins a city by releasing a toxin that causes people's abilities to spiral out of control, Japan's greatest heroes spread around the world in an attempt to track down the mastermind and put him to justice.
